status: PRE-REGISTERED EXPECTATION — pending real analysis, NOT a result
modality_context: KO (Shifrut/Marson primary human CD8 T-cell CRISPR-KO screens); concordance rule: concordant = protective_lof
io_rationale: E3 ubiquitin ligase; sets TCR activation threshold and T-cell anergy. KO lowers the costimulation requirement and boosts anti-tumor immunity — canonical positive-control enhancer in T-cell KO screens.

tractability.evidence: ChEMBL target CHEMBL4879459; >20 PDB structures; Pharos-listed. Oral CBL-B inhibitors already in the clinic (see known_drugs).
tractability.ot_tractability: OT-CONFIRMED 2026-07-11 (see open_targets_live): small-molecule Structure-with-Ligand=true, High-Quality-Ligand=true; OT Approved/Advanced/Phase-1 SM buckets still false (OT snapshot predates the CBL-B inhibitor trials, same lag as ChEMBL v34).

genetic_evidence.anchor_disease: multiple sclerosis, type 1 diabetes, autoimmune thyroid disease
genetic_evidence.rationale: CBLB variants/reduced function are associated with increased autoimmune risk; Cblb-/- mice develop spontaneous autoimmunity. LoF -> autoimmune RISK.
genetic_evidence.interpretation_note: risk_lof (autoimmune) = mechanistically supportive for an IO KO though 'discordant' under a strict cancer-anchored rule.

clinical_programs_direct.name: APN401
clinical_programs_direct.modality: ex vivo autologous immune cells transfected with CBL-B-silencing siRNA (RNAi cell therapy)
clinical_programs_direct.note: COMPLETED 2024-10-01 (advanced solid tumors); a SECOND modality drugging CBL-B (cell therapy vs small molecule). Found live via ClinicalTrials.gov 2026-07-11.

known_drugs.note: 0 mechanisms in ChEMBL v34 (inhibitors post-date the release); confirmed via ClinicalTrials.gov. CBL-B is now clinically drugged across TWO modalities: oral small-molecule inhibitors (NX-1607, HST-1011) + ex vivo RNAi cell therapy (APN401).

active_trials.note: Two active oral CBL-B inhibitor programs in advanced solid tumors.

safety_flags: Immune-related adverse events plausible (mechanism-based, as with checkpoint blockade).

open_targets_live.status: REAL — first successful OT query in 5 watcher runs (OT recovered briefly, then re-throttled globally)
open_targets_live.tractability_note: OT confirms small-molecule tractability via structure + high-quality ligand; clinical-bucket flags still false because the OT data snapshot predates the CBL-B inhibitor trials (same lag as ChEMBL v34).
open_targets_live.interpretation: OT-CONFIRMS genome-wide-significant genetic association of CBLB to autoimmune/immune diseases (hypothyroidism, urticaria, MS) — the human-genetic signature of a real T-cell brake. Association strength is OT-native; the protective-vs-risk DIRECTION (risk_lof) stays mechanism/PubMed-grounded because the OT association endpoint returns strength, not signed effect. Upgrades CBLB genetic_evidence from 'literature_expectation' to OT-corroborated at the association level.
open_targets_live.concordance_impact: No change to funnel counts — CBLB was already any_gwas=true / genome_wide_sig=true / risk_lof in concordance_snapshot.json; OT corroborates those values (funnel stays 8/2/1/1/0).
